build.title: No questions at login + headless Claude Code sessions shown in the console Terminal

said.text: claude-pick starts on the Claude plan + Opus without menus (claude-pick --ask for them); session check-in asks nothing unless its config says ask: true; every headless launch (systems check, push banner, Build manager Start build now) runs through deploy/claude-headless.sh in a tmux session axf-…, and the console Terminal opens each new one in a VPS tab attached to it and brings the window to the front (setting showHeadless). tmux host check + Auto fix.
